source_text: De verbi autem administratione quid dicam, cum hoc sit negotium illis, non ethnicos convertendi, sed nostros evertendi? Hanc magis gloriam captant, si stantibus ruinam, non si jacentibus elevationem operentur; quoniam et ipsum opus eorum non de suo proprio aedificio venit, sed de veritatis destructione. Nostra suffodiunt, ut sua aedificent. Adime illis legem Moysi, et Prophetas, et creatorem Deum, accusationem eloqui non habent. Ita fit ut ruinas facilius operentur stantium aedificiorum, quam exstructiones jacentium ruinarum. Ad haec solummodo opera humiles, et blandi, et summissi agunt. Caeterum, nec suis praesidibus reverentiam noverunt. Et hoc est quod schismata apud haereticos fere non sunt; quia, cum sint, non parent. Schisma est unitas ipsis. Mentior si non etiam a regulis suis variant inter se, dum unusquisque proinde suo arbitrio modulatur quae accepit, quemadmodum de suo arbitrio ea composuit ille qui tradidit. Agnoscit naturam suam, et originis suae morem, profectus rei. Idem licuit Valentinianis quod Valentino, idem Marcionitis quod Marcioni, de arbitrio suo fidem innovare. Denique penitus inspectae haereses omnes in multis cum auctoribus dissentientes deprehenduntur. Plerique nec Ecclesias habent, sine matre, sine sede, orbi fide, extorres, sine lare vagantur.
pass_a_gloss: But what shall I say about the administration of the Word, since this is the business of those people, not to convert Gentiles, but to overthrow our people? They strive for this glory more, if they work ruin for those standing, not elevation for those lying down; because even their own work does not come from building their own thing, but from destroying the truth. They undermine ours, so that they may build their own. Take away from them the law of Moses, and the Prophets, and the Creator God, they do not have an accusation to speak. It happens that they work more easily to make ruins of standing buildings, than to make constructions from lying-down ruins. To these things only they act humble, and flattering, and submissive. But, they do not know reverence for their own leaders. And this is what happens, that schisms among heretics are hardly found; because, when they are, they do not obey. Schism is unity to them. I am lying if even they do not vary from their own rules among themselves, while each one modulates what he received according to his own judgment, just as he who handed it down composed it according to his own judgment. The thing itself acknowledges its own nature, and the custom of its origin, having proceeded from it. The same thing was allowed to the Valentinians as to Valentinus, the same to the Marcionites as to Marcion, to innovate the faith according to their own judgment. Finally, all heresies, having been thoroughly examined, are found disagreeing with their authors in many things. Many of them do not even have Churches, without a mother, without a seat, with a faith that is orphaned, they wander as exiles, without a home.

pass_b_english: What can I say about their handling of the Word, when their real business is not converting Gentiles but overthrowing our own people? They chase glory by wrecking those who stand firm rather than raising up those who have fallen, because their very work does not come from building something of their own but from destroying the truth. They undermine ours so they can build theirs. Strip them of the law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Creator God, and they have no accusation left to speak. That is why they find it easier to turn standing buildings into ruins than to raise constructions from ruins already lying on the ground. Only for this purpose do they play the humble, flattering, and submissive. Otherwise, they do not even know reverence for their own leaders. And that is why schisms among heretics are practically non-existent: when they arise, no one obeys them. To them, schism is unity. I would be lying if I said they do not even vary among themselves from their own rules, each one reshaping what he received according to his own judgment, just as the one who handed it down composed it according to his own judgment. The movement itself acknowledges its own nature and the habit of its origin, because it proceeded from that very source. The same license was granted to the Valentinians as to Valentinus, and to the Marcionites as to Marcion: to innovate the faith according to their own judgment. In the end, every heresy, thoroughly examined, is caught disagreeing with its own author on many points. Most of them do not even have churches; motherless, seatless, with an orphaned faith, they wander as exiles without a home.

review.notes: All clauses in the Latin source were checked against Pass A and Pass B. Pass A preserves the sense of all clauses, and Pass B provides a fluent rendering that does not contradict the Latin or Pass A. The translation of 'extorres, sine lare vagantur' as 'wander as exiles, without a home' (Pass A) and 'wander as exiles without a home' (Pass B) is an accurate rendering of the sense. The title 'Heretics' Methods' names the thought of the chapter.
